assessments.summary: The supplied argument establishes all stated necessary conditions. The imported Marton-to-input bounds yield coordinatewise and sum-marginal concave envelopes; together with the exact decomposition G=F(q_1)+F(q_2)-C_out/2 and the certified threshold T=2L_RTD, these force q_1,q_2∈(3/8,5/8), 17/20<Q<23/20, and C_out<7/160<0.044. The channel’s affine output laws and Pinsker’s inequality then imply |c_in|<7/40. On the reflected/transposed one-parameter family, monotonicity and certified endpoint evaluations of the output correlation force 1/8<alpha<5/13. The proof correctly establishes only necessary conditions for M>T.
scopeQualifications: Applies to the governed half-skew BSSC product channel P^{otimes 2}.
Applies to the unnormalized finite-auxiliary Marton sum value.
The conclusions are necessary conditions conditional on M>T.
It neither constructs nor proves a two-letter gain.
It does not rule out a two-letter gain.
It is not a capacity converse.
From the threshold reference, only the unconditional RTD calculus and interval certificate are needed; neither (H-Marton) nor (H-binary) is used.
